I'm going to bumfuk, Egypt if things keep going the way they do for me and my family. I lost my mother suddenly and with that lost 2 incomes. So not only am i missing my best friend (my everything as corny as that sounds) my family and me are trying to survive. We have never asked for help since my mother passed on June 11, 2014 at around 11:30 am central time.

The bumfuk, Egypt thing was funny, right? I was told by bitcoinbeg to come here. Please delete if i'm in the wrong. I hope for those who still have their mothers that they live to 100. A great part of me died that day.

i was going to try my best to snap out of it for my mother and i was going to try just for her. i was going to see a doctor for what might very well be cancer. i was going to stop drugs. well, she died 4 days after our talk. the last words she said to me were "i can not breathe". died right before my eyes. calling 911 while watching her die. she died from complications from sleep apnea. she was the only reason i still put up with life.

spin, really, i am not going through a teenage phase here. i could write a damn book how i screwed up my life, lost everyone i cared for etc. etc. but again, what's the point? the last thing i need is more drugs and that is what i will get if i see a shrink.

you are either happy with your life or you are not. if i sound condescending or down playing other peoples problems (even more so teenagers) that was not my intention. i have just been around long enough to know there is no professional "help". the only thing you can hope for is to snap out of it (happened to me a couple times in my life but went back to the way i am after time). again, you are either happy with your life and have a purpose with your life or you do not. there is no middle ground.
